title: Analogue Drums: Boss DR-110
summary: Walk-through of the 1983 Boss DR-110 schematic: CPU board, voicing board, noise and cymbal generator, the Roland-style swing-type VCA, and the bass and snare drum voices.

sources.title: Analogue Drums: Boss DR-110 Drum Machine
